branch_and_bound.cost: O((2*max_coeff+1)^n), exact inside the box, refuses n > 8
branch_and_bound.acceptance: minimal-l1 vector inside the box with |m.x| <= eps
branch_and_bound.scope: coefficients inside max_coeff and at most eight inputs

lll_pslq.cost: polynomial in n for fixed precision; coefficient range is not a box
lll_pslq.acceptance: exact rational substitution, plus a size margin against the generic 10^(digits/n) vector and a residual above the embedding rounding floor unless the residual is exactly zero
lll_pslq.scope: any n; coefficients bounded only by what the reduction reaches

design.cases: eight hand-built cases with a declared criterion and a declared scope each, plus three seeded random families
design.not_a_distribution_why: the random families are produced by a fixed generator, not sampled from the questions real work asks: the two planted families always carry a relation and the independent family never does. Their pass rates say whether each searcher does what its contract says on that generator, and nothing about discovery-rate in general
design.randomized: seed=20261102, 40 cases per family drawn by random.Random(seed) in family order, so re-running the script reproduces the case list; a seed without the generator parameters would reproduce nothing
design.assessment_rule: a refusal inside a method's documented scope is `wrong`; a refusal outside it is `refused_out_of_scope`, which is not an error
design.precision: start_digits=17 is what an f64 carries; escalation adds coefficient range, not information, and the residual guards reject relations the embedding would otherwise manufacture
design.float_limit: a relation among f64 inputs must clear digits_of_residual + n*log10(max|m|) working digits; for n=3 and |m|~10^2 that is about 21, which an f64 cannot supply. The outside-the-box case therefore uses exactly representable dyadic values, so its zero residual is a property of the inputs and not of the arithmetic
design.timing: measured on one machine in a single process against an optimised build; the branch-and-bound cost is combinatorial in n and the box, so its small-case time says nothing about larger inputs
design.independent_irrationals: eps=1e-300 is below any residual the f64 values admit, so both searchers must refuse: the case tests refusal, not reach
